summary: BCB Bancorp Inc filed a preliminary prospectus supplement under Rule 424(b)(5), covering a firm-commitment follow-on offering of common stock at an undisclosed price per share. Piper Sandler is the sole underwriter, with a 30-day option for additional shares. Last reported sale price was $8.58 on September 11, 2026. Terms including price, share count and proceeds are blank. This is a routine shelf takedown, not a special situation; watch pricing, discount to market and use of proceeds for capital adequacy or growth.
